title: Add tests for smart folder generation
description: Add unit and integration tests covering predicates, plist output, Build orchestration, tag injection, DistinctTags, and CLI regeneration.
design: Create internal/smartfolder/smartfolder_test.go with table-driven tests for predicate, plist, Build, and stale-file removal. Add tests to internal/actions/actions_test.go for filemaid tag injection. Add TestDistinctTags to internal/state/state_test.go. Add an integration test to internal/cli/integration_test.go that processes a file with a fake classifier and asserts the expected .savedSearch files exist under the temp SmartFoldersDir.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] go test ./internal/smartfolder/... passes
- [ ] go test ./internal/actions/... passes
- [ ] go test ./internal/state/... passes
- [ ] go test ./internal/cli/... passes
- [ ] Integration test creates Documents.savedSearch and tag savedSearch files

title: Wire smart folder regeneration into CLI
description: Add the 'filemaid smart-folders' command and auto-regenerate Smart Folders after process and scan runs.
design: Create internal/cli/smartfolders.go with regenerateSmartFolders() and a new cobra command 'smart-folders'. It collects categories from cfg.Categories, tags from db.DistinctTags(), scopes from expanded cfg.AllowedDirs (falling back to home), and calls smartfolder.Build. Hook regenerateSmartFolders() into processCmd.RunE and scanCmd.RunE after their existing work, logging failures as warnings without failing the command.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] 'filemaid smart-folders' regenerates the Smart Folder directory
- [ ] 'filemaid process' and 'filemaid scan' regenerate Smart Folders on success
- [ ] Regeneration failure does not fail the process/scan command
- [ ] Command returns an error if SmartFolders is disabled in config

title: Build smartfolder Build orchestrator
description: Implement smartfolder.Build that creates the Smart Folder directory, removes stale .savedSearch files, and writes one file per category and per unique tag.
design: Create internal/smartfolder/smartfolder.go with Build(categories, tags, scopes, dir). Create dir with 0755. List existing .savedSearch entries and remove them for a clean cutover. For each non-empty category call categoryPredicate and writeSavedSearch. For each non-empty tag (excluding 'filemaid') call tagPredicate and writeSavedSearch. Normalize filenames by replacing '/' with '-' and trimming whitespace. Return the first error but attempt all writes.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Build creates one .savedSearch per category and per tag
- [ ] Stale .savedSearch files from previous runs are removed
- [ ] Empty or 'filemaid' tags are skipped
- [ ] Empty categories list produces no category files
- [ ] Nil input slices do not panic

title: Add DistinctTags repository query
description: Add a DistinctTags method to state.Repo that returns all unique Finder tags ever applied by filemaid, excluding the 'filemaid' tag itself.
design: Add DistinctTags() ([]string, error) to the Repo interface in internal/state/state.go. Implement it in State by querying SELECT tags FROM history, splitting each comma-joined string, trimming whitespace, filtering empty and 'filemaid' values, and returning a sorted slice. Also implement DistinctTags in internal/state/fake.go so tests can use FakeRepo.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] DistinctTags returns unique tags across all history rows
- [ ] 'filemaid' is never returned
- [ ] NULL or empty tags columns are handled without error
- [ ] FakeRepo returns the same set from in-memory records

title: Build smartfolder plist writer
description: Implement writeSavedSearch that emits a valid macOS .savedSearch XML plist from a predicate string and search scopes.
design: Create internal/smartfolder/plist.go with writeSavedSearch(path, name, rawQuery, scopes). Use text/template and the exact XML plist structure from the plan (CompatibleVersion, RawQuery, RawQueryDict with FinderFilesOnly/UserFilesOnly/SearchScopes, SearchCriteria with CurrentFolderPath/FXScopeArrayOfPaths). Do not introduce a third-party plist library.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Generated files parse as XML plists
- [ ] RawQuery appears verbatim inside <string> elements
- [ ] SearchScopes, CurrentFolderPath, and FXScopeArrayOfPaths contain all provided scopes
- [ ] Files are written with .savedSearch extension

title: Build smartfolder NSPredicate builder
description: Implement categoryPredicate and tagPredicate functions that produce valid macOS Spotlight NSPredicate strings for .savedSearch files.
design: Create internal/smartfolder/predicate.go. categoryPredicate requires the 'filemaid' tag and ORs tag equality, filename LIKE, Finder comment LIKE, and text content LIKE for the category keyword. tagPredicate requires the 'filemaid' tag and exact tag equality. All comparisons use 'cd' for case/diacritic insensitivity. Escape double quotes in names. Return empty string for empty names so callers skip them.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] categoryPredicate('Documents') contains kMDItemUserTags, kMDItemFSName, kMDItemFinderComment, and kMDItemTextContent clauses
- [ ] categoryPredicate('') returns empty string
- [ ] tagPredicate('work') requires both 'filemaid' and 'work' tags
- [ ] Names containing double quotes are escaped

title: Add smart_folders config fields
description: Extend the filemaid Config struct with SmartFolders (bool) and SmartFoldersDir (string) and set defaults in Defaults().
design: Add fields to internal/config/config.go Config struct with json tags 'smart_folders' and 'smart_folders_dir'. Set SmartFolders: true and SmartFoldersDir: '~/Documents/Filemaid' in Defaults(). No migration or schema change is needed because Load() deep-merges defaults with user config.
acceptance_criteria: - [ ] Config marshals/unmarshals the new fields\n- [ ] Defaults() returns SmartFolders=true and SmartFoldersDir='~/Documents/Filemaid'\n- [ ] Existing configs without these keys still load successfully

title: Inject filemaid tag into processed files
description: Ensure every file processed by filemaid carries the 'filemaid' Finder tag when Smart Folders are enabled, even if general tag writing is disabled.
design: Modify internal/actions/actions.go Apply(). Build the tag slice conditionally: if cfg.Tags, append decision.Tags plus subcategory and category; if cfg.SmartFolders, prepend 'filemaid'. Write tags with SetTags whenever the final slice is non-empty. This scopes Smart Folders to filemaid-processed files without changing behavior when SmartFolders is disabled.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] When SmartFolders=true, processed files receive 'filemaid' tag as the first tag
- [ ] When SmartFolders=false, no 'filemaid' tag is added
- [ ] When cfg.Tags=false but SmartFolders=true, only the 'filemaid' tag is written
- [ ] Nil or empty decision.Tags do not panic

title: Implement dynamic Smart Folders for filemaid
description: Create a Filemaid Smart Folder directory that regenerates on every filemaid run. Generate one .savedSearch per configured category and one per unique Finder tag applied by filemaid. Scope every search to files tagged 'filemaid' and combine tag, filename, Finder comment, and Spotlight content matches. Null/empty tags and comments must not break generation or predicates.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] A 'filemaid' tag is written to every processed file when Smart Folders are enabled
- [ ] ~/Documents/Filemaid contains .savedSearch files for each configured category and each historical tag
- [ ] Every saved search only returns files tagged 'filemaid'
- [ ] Empty/null tags or comments do not crash or produce invalid predicates
- [ ] Smart folders regenerate automatically after process/scan and via 'filemaid smart-folders'

title: Skip LLM classification for duplicate files
description: In internal/cli/process.go, isDuplicate is computed during preprocessing but every duplicate still calls classifier.Classify. For duplicates that do NOT match cfg.SafeDeletePatterns, set a review decision before spawning the goroutine and skip the Ollama round-trip. Only classify duplicates when they may be promoted to delete by SafeDeletePatterns.

title: Check decision cache in preprocessing
description: In internal/cli/process.go, after computing fileHash call db.FindDecisionByHash(fileHash). If a cached decision exists, apply it directly without acquiring a worker semaphore or calling classifier.Classify. This removes per-file goroutine overhead for already-seen content and frees workers for files that actually need the model.

title: Verify smart folders end-to-end on macOS
description: Build filemaid and manually verify that processing a test file creates the expected Smart Folder files and applies the 'filemaid' tag.
design: Build the binary with 'go build -o /tmp/filemaid ./cmd/filemaid'. Create a temp text file, run '/tmp/filemaid process' on it, then inspect ~/Documents/Filemaid for .savedSearch files and use 'mdls -name kMDItemUserTags' to confirm the 'filemaid' tag is present. Also test the null-safety path by processing a file whose classifier returns nil Tags and empty Reason.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Processed file has the 'filemaid' Finder tag
- [ ] ~/Documents/Filemaid contains the expected .savedSearch files
- [ ] Opened .savedSearch file contains the 'filemaid' predicate
- [ ] Null/empty tags and comments do not prevent Smart Folder generation

title: P2 Update CLI output and review for renames

Record original_name and new_name in history. Add tests for all rename levels, collisions, similar-content review, and invalid-name fallback.

Add tests for schema migration and lookups.

Users can tune concurrency for their GPU and reduce image payload size when 1024px is unnecessary for classification.

Batch or defer mdimport calls in internal/actions/fs.go so a batch of N files in the same directory triggers one Spotlight re-index instead of N.

title: P3 Update default config and documentation for rename feature

title: Enable SQLite WAL and parallelize preprocessing hashing
description: Open the SQLite state database with PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL in internal/state/state.go to support concurrent writers. Compute file hashes concurrently in internal/cli/process.go preprocessing up to a small limit, preserving result ordering.

title: Modernize Ollama client request handling
description: In internal/llm/llm.go: pass context.Context through Classify/requestChat/requestGenerate/postJSON, add configurable RequestTimeout to Config, replace map[string]any decoding with concrete response structs, make checkModel cache a map keyed by (url, model) instead of a single tuple, and split promptTemplate into system + user messages. NOTE: Ollama /api/chat request system messages override the Modelfile SYSTEM prompt, so any request-level system message must include the full classifier instructions or we must keep them in the Modelfile and only send a user message.
close_reason: Implemented prompt deduplication, context propagation, configurable request_timeout, concrete Ollama response structs, and per-(url,model) checkModel cache.
